raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "go to work"
  role subject "Silviu"
  role instrument "bicycle"
  polarity affirmed
  basis closure

@q query
  mode explain
  where match
    relation "go to work"
    role subject "Mihai"
    role instrument ?how
    polarity affirmed
  end
  select ?how
